protocol_notes.W_data: class-preserving pixel Euclidean W2 on canonical224RGB[0,1] training images; exact assignment and paired displacement certificate
protocol_notes.W_CF: exact Euclidean W2 in original unnormalized W512 for all three geometry terms
protocol_notes.robust_risk: max_model mean_CF hinge, tau0.5; shared bank; no current-validity checks
protocol_notes.identity: unavailable in original face pipeline; report missing rather than invent a score
protocol_notes.recourse_cost: pixel L2 at canonical224 and native1024; original SqueezeNet LPIPS, PSNR and SSIM as secondary metrics
protocol_notes.base_fails: retain every prespecified factual even if Base does not reach target
protocol_notes.runtime: from new generated data and pretrained assets through Base/bank/calibration/refinement/freeze; excludes original pretraining and final future evaluation
